app.name: Inventory
app.description: What's about to expire, and what to order.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Password, or we'll email you a link.
signIn.passwordHint: Leave blank to get a sign-in link by email instead.
signIn.sent: If that address can sign in here, a link is on its way. Check your email.
signIn.sentHint: Accounts are created by invitation, so nothing arrives for an address that hasn't been added yet.
signIn.error: That didn't work. Check the address and try again.
signIn.throttled: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.

scan.cameraUnavailable: Camera unavailable. Type the barcode instead.

waste.title: Write off
waste.notEnoughStock: That's more than the stock on hand.

dashboard.title: Expiring soon
dashboard.batchCount: {count, plural, =0 {No batches} one {# batch} other {# batches}} expiring within 14 days
dashboard.nothingExpiring: Not a single batch in the next 14 days. Keep it that way — count a shelf while you are ahead.
dashboard.daysLeft: {days, plural, =0 {Expires today} one {# day left} other {# days left}}
dashboard.expiredDaysAgo: {days, plural, one {Expired # day ago} other {Expired # days ago}}
dashboard.batchSummary: {batches, plural, one {# batch} other {# batches}}{expired, plural, =0 {} other { · # already expired}}

products.title: Products
products.emptyBody: Import a CSV from your supplier or wholesaler. Two thousand products is one upload, not one afternoon.
products.noMatchesBody: Try the barcode, or part of the name.
products.name: Name
products.invalidBarcode: That isn't a valid barcode (GTIN-8, -12, -13 or -14).
products.saveFailed: Couldn't save that. Check the fields and try again.
products.noStockBody: Receive a delivery and the batches will appear here with their expiry dates.
products.daysLeft: {days, plural, =0 {expires today} one {# day left} other {# days left}}
products.expiredDaysAgo: {days, plural, one {expired # day ago} other {expired # days ago}}
products.noMovements: Nothing has moved this product yet.
products.isWeighedHint: Deli, cheese and produce have no barcode on the item. Weigh it at the till and type the weight. Set the unit to kg or g and price per that unit.

home.noOrganization: Your account isn't a member of any organization yet. Ask an owner to add you.

denied.manager: That needs a manager account. Ask an owner to change your role.

home.signInHint: Use your password, or we'll email you a link.

pitch.expiry: See what is about to expire, worst value first.
pitch.reorder: Get told what to order, from your own consumption.
pitch.autoStock: Every sale updates stock automatically. Nothing to count by hand.

count.title: Stock count
count.savedHint: Saved. Scan it again to change it.
count.countedSoFar: {count, plural, =0 {nothing counted} one {# counted} other {# counted}}
count.noVariance: Everything matches the ledger. Nothing to adjust.
count.varianceCount: {count, plural, one {# line differs} other {# lines differ}}
count.postAdjustments: {count, plural, =0 {Finish count} one {Post # adjustment} other {Post # adjustments}}
count.dueTitle: {count, plural, one {# product due a count} other {# products due a count}}
count.daysOver: {days, plural, =0 {due today} one {# day over} other {# days over}}
count.taken: Someone is already counting that product on {section}. Finish that count first, or carry on with something else.
count.otherCounts: {count, plural, one {# other count open} other {# other counts open}}
count.otherCountsHint: Started by someone else. Anything on their list cannot be counted twice.
count.linesCounted: {count, plural, =0 {nothing counted} one {# counted} other {# counted}}
count.viewingOther: You are finishing a count someone else started.
count.shrinkHint: Missing against what real sales say should be on the shelf — theft, spoilage, or a miscount.
count.gainHint: More on the shelf than the ledger expected — check for a delivery that was never logged.

reorder.title: What to order
reorder.nothingToOrderBody: No product is below its minimum with a consumption rate behind it. Look again after the next count.
reorder.leadTime: {days, plural, one {# day lead time} other {# days lead time}}
reorder.notEnoughData: {count, plural, one {# product has} other {# products have}} no consumption rate yet. Count them twice to get a suggestion.

receive.title: Receive delivery
receive.expiryHint: Suggested from a {days}-day shelf life. Change it if the label differs.
receive.failed: Couldn’t record that. Check the quantity and try again.

import.title: Import products
import.intro: Upload a spreadsheet exported as CSV. Rows are matched on barcode, so importing the same file again updates instead of duplicating.
import.imported: {created, plural, =0 {No new products} one {# product added} other {# products added}}, {updated, plural, =0 {none updated} one {# updated} other {# updated}}.
import.problemSummary: {rows} rows read, {problems} need fixing. Correct them in your spreadsheet and upload again.
import.unknownSuppliers: Suppliers not in your list yet: {names}. Add them first, or clear the column.
import.formatBody: One row per product. Only a name column is required — everything else is optional. Commas, semicolons and Excel exports all work.
import.formatColumns: Recognised columns: name, barcode, case_barcode, units_per_case, sku, unit, cost, price, min_stock, shelf_life_days, supplier.

problems.invalidBarcode: Barcode is not a valid GTIN (8, 12, 13 or 14 digits)
problems.duplicateInFile: The same barcode appears more than once in this file
problems.invalidCaseBarcode: Case barcode is not a valid GTIN (8, 12, 13 or 14 digits)
problems.duplicateCaseBarcodeInFile: The same case barcode appears more than once in this file
problems.invalidUnit: Unit must be one of: each, kg, g, l, ml
problems.notANumber: Price or quantity is not a number
problems.notAWholeNumber: Shelf life must be a whole number of days
problems.unknownSupplier: Supplier is not in your supplier list
problems.missingNameColumn: No name column found. The first row must be headers.

reports.title: Reports
reports.rowCount: {count, plural, =0 {No rows} one {# row} other {# rows}}
reports.emptyBody: Nothing was recorded in this period. Try a longer one.

blurbs.stock: Everything you hold and what it is worth.
blurbs.waste: What was binned, why, and what it cost you.
blurbs.expiry: Money sitting in stock that is about to stop being sellable.
blurbs.low-stock: Products under their minimum, with the supplier to call.
blurbs.sales: What sold, by product, and what it brought in.

orders.title: Purchase orders
orders.emptyBody: Orders start from what your own consumption says you need — not from a blank form.
orders.sendHint: Send this order to the supplier yourself, then mark it sent. Only then does it count against future reorder suggestions.
orders.receiveHint: Quantities are pre-filled with what is still outstanding. Clear a line to skip it.
orders.overDelivered: {count, plural, one {# line was} other {# lines were}} over-delivered. The stock is recorded — check the invoice.

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.emptyBody: Add one before importing a catalogue that names them. Lead time is what turns a low stock warning into an order quantity.
suppliers.name: Name
suppliers.leadTimeHint: How many days between ordering and delivery. Drives every reorder quantity.
suppliers.saveFailed: Couldn’t save that. A supplier with this name may already exist.

vat.title: VAT rates
vat.intro: Used to value your stock. This is not an invoicing or tax-filing tool.
vat.countryHint: Sets your starting rates. You can change any of them afterwards.
vat.historyNote: Changing a rate records a new one from today. Past valuations keep the rate that applied then.

errors.unknownCountry: No starting rates for that country yet. Enter them by hand instead.
errors.invalidRate: A rate must be between 0 and 100.

team.title: Team
team.intro: Invite someone by email. They sign in with a link like everyone else, and join automatically the first time.
team.pendingTitle: {count, plural, one {# pending invitation} other {# pending invitations}}
team.roleHint: Staff scan, receive, count and write off. Managers also edit products, suppliers and orders. Owners also change settings and the team.
team.invitedNote: Invitation recorded. They join when they first sign in — tell them to expect it.

errors.invalidEmail: That does not look like an email address.
errors.lastOwner: An organization must keep at least one owner.
errors.unknown: That did not work. Try again.

team.invitedSent: Invitation sent. They join this shop the first time they sign in.
team.invitedNoMail: Invitation created — but no email was sent.
team.invitedNoMailHint: Tell them to sign in with this address. They join this shop automatically the first time they do.
team.invitedMailFailed: Invitation created, but the email could not be sent.
team.noMailProvider: No mail provider is configured, so invitations are not emailed. Add RESEND_API_KEY and MAIL_FROM to send them.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.body: That screen failed to load. It is usually temporary.
errors.notFoundBody: That page does not exist, or it belongs to another shop.

firstRun.title: Get set up
firstRun.intro: Three steps and this screen starts telling you what is about to expire.

catalogue.title: Load your products
catalogue.body: Upload a CSV from your wholesaler, or add a few by hand.

receive.title: Receive a delivery
receive.body: Scan or type a barcode, then the quantity and expiry date.

count.title: Count a shelf
count.body: Count the same products twice and the app works out how fast they sell.

categories.title: Categories
categories.emptyBody: Group products so counts can be scoped to a section and reports can break down by it.
categories.name: Name
categories.countFrequencyHint: New products in this category start with this frequency. Each product can still be changed individually.
categories.deleteWarning: {count, plural, one {# product will lose this category.} other {# products will lose this category.}}
categories.saveFailed: Couldn't save that. A category with this name may already exist.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.cartEmptyBody: Scan or type a barcode to add the first item.
checkout.insufficientStock: That's more than the stock on hand.
checkout.unpriced: This product has no sell price set. Add one before selling it.
checkout.failed: Couldn't complete that sale. Try again.
checkout.voided: Sale voided. Stock has been restored.
checkout.orSearchHint: Scan it, or type part of the name for anything sold loose.

store.title: Store
store.intro: Name, country and currency — used on VAT rates and every money format in the app.
store.name: Store name
store.countryHint: Changing this does not re-seed VAT rates. Adjust them separately if you move countries.
store.timezoneHint: An IANA time zone name, e.g. Europe/Berlin.
store.saveFailed: Couldn't save that. Check the fields and try again.
